group.description: Name of the process group to which the process to be created is to be added

metas.description: List of attachments of the selected workflow

startDate.description: Date on which the process can be started

group.description: Process group to which you belong

certificates.description: Certificates identifiers and pins list (only in the multi cert sign step)

delegatedUser.description: The user whose signature is delegated

filename.description: File name (only for the upload step)

idCert.description: Certificate signing identifier (only in the sign step)

metas.description: Changed attachment (only for the modify meta step)

otp.description: Challenge response (only in OTP sign step)

pin.description: Certificate PIN (only in the signature step and if the certificate needs it)

action.description: Accept or Reject the step. Can be: OK | DENY

comment.description: The message introduced by the user if any

timestamp.description: Time that the user executed the step

userId.description: The user that performed the operation

userType.description: type of the user. Can be: SIGNER

reportFormat.description: Report format. Can be "SIMPLE", "DETAILED", "DIAGNOSTIC" or "ALL". Default is "SIMPLE"

signedFileB64.description: Signed file to be validated in Base64

validationLevel.description: Validation level. Can be "B", "LT" or "A". Default is "B". Level "A" is for "LTA" signatures only

expirationDate.description: Date on which the process expires

filename.description: Name of the file to be used in the process

hash.description: Hash of the file to be used in the process

metas.description: List of the attached data in the process

processGroup.description: Information on the process group to which the process belongs

startDate.description: Date from which the process is available

steps.description: List of steps in the process

workflow.description: Name of the workflow on which the process is based

email.description: Email of the external user who must execute the step

externalUser.description: Flag to indicate if the user is external

groups.description: List of groups of users who can execute the step

involvedUsers.description: Information on who has executed a step as a group member

remainingUsers.description: Numbers of users who must perform the step (if groups are defined)

username.description: User in charge of executing the step

actualStep.description: Flag indicating if it is the current step

commentary.description: Comment added when executing the step

editableMeta.description: List of modifiable attachments in this step

responsibleStep.description: Information on who should execute or has executed the step

showMeta.description: List of attachments visible in this step

fileType.description: Type of file supported for the creation of the process

groups.description: List of groups for which they are visible (only if the scope is private)

metas.description: List of data attached that the workflow has

steps.description: List of steps that the workflow has

validPeriod.description: Default validity time of the processes created with this workflow
